description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Obstinate Gargoyle
When Obstinate Gargoyle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Obstinate Gargoyle enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Obstinate Gargoyle
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
